notablePrerequisites:
Medomai the Ageless and Felhide Spiritbinder do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Felhide Spiritbinder.
An opponent cannot block Medomai the Ageless.
description:
Declare Medomai the Ageless and Felhide Spiritbinder as attackers.
When Medomai the Ageless deals combat damage to a player, it triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Felhide Spiritbinder untaps in your next extra turn's untap step, it triggers, allowing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Identity Thief with haste.
Declare the Identity Thief token and Felhide Spiritbinder as attackers.
The Identity Thief token triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless, becoming a copy of Medomai the Ageless until end of turn, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
When the Identity Thief token deals combat damage to a player, it triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, the delayed triggered ability from step 5 triggers, returning Medomai the Ageless from exile to the battlefield.
Let the Identity Thief token die to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.
